# Apple Podcasts

> Apple Podcasts is a platform for discovering, browsing, and listening to podcasts across news, true crime, comedy, and lifestyle genres.

Apple Podcasts hosts thousands of podcast series from major publishers like The New York Times, NPR, ABC News, and independent creators. The platform features curated charts, trending shows, and new releases across multiple categories including investigative journalism, true crime, news briefings, and interview-based content.

## Key Topics

- True Crime Podcast
- Investigative Journalism
- Podcast Discovery
- Murder Investigation
- Serial Killer
- News Briefing
- Documentary Series
- Trending Podcasts
- Podcast Charts
- Crime Junkie

- NPR
- Dateline NBC
- iHeartPodcasts

## Discovery & Charts

- [Top Podcast Charts - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/charts): View top-ranked and trending podcasts across Apple Podcasts charts
- [Apple Podcasts - Web Player](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/new): Browse new and trending podcast releases on Apple Podcasts
- [New Shows Podcasts - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/room/555360674): Curated collection of newly released podcast series

## News & Current Events

- [The Daily - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-daily/id1200361736): New York Times daily news podcast with Barbaro and Abrams
- [Up First from NPR - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/up-first-from-npr/id1222114325): NPR's daily news briefing with Fadel, Inskeep, and team

## True Crime & Investigative Series

- [Crime Junkie - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/crime-junkie/id1322200189): Audiochuck's true-crime podcast hosted by Flowers and Prawat
- [Dateline NBC - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/dateline-nbc/id1464919521): NBC News true-crime podcast with investigative journalism
- [Killer In The Code - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/killer-in-the-code/id1863557288): Michael Connelly's true-crime series on cold cases and serial killers
- [Bridge of Lies - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/bridge-of-lies/id1874641982): ABC News true-crime series on Sarah Stern murder investigation
- [Someone's Hunting Us - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/someone%E2%80%99s-hunting-us/id1870901751): NJ.com investigative series on serial killer Khalil Wheeler-Weaver
- [Off Duty | The Guardian Investigates - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-birth-keepers-i-choose-this/id1731314182): Guardian investigative journalism on Chicago crime and misconduct
- [City of Lights - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/city-of-lights/id1867051800): True-crime podcast on unsolved Aurora, Illinois murder case

## Interview & Commentary Shows

- [The Joe Rogan Experience - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-joe-rogan-experience/id360084272): Joe Rogan's interview and comedy podcast series
- [REAL AF with Andy Frisella - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/real-af-with-andy-frisella/id1012570406): Andy Frisella's entrepreneurship and commentary podcast
- [Mick Unplugged - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/mick-unplugged/id1731755953): Mick Hunt's self-improvement and leadership podcast

## Documentary & History

- [The Secret World of Roald Dahl - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-secret-world-of-roald-dahl/id1868436905): Listen to iHeartPodcasts's documentary on Roald Dahl biography
- [Real Vikings - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/real-vikings/id1876255143): Noiser's historical podcast on Viking age and medieval history

## Optional

- [The Psychology of Relationships - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-psychology-of-relationships/id1852111386): Psychology and relationship advice podcast by Krafchick & Xu
- [Sound, Light & Frequency - Podcast - Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/sound%2C-light-%26-frequency/id1876651405): iHeartPodcasts UFO disclosure and conspiracy investigation series
